headline: EVERY COMPONENT NOW HAS A PAGE THAT RENDERS IT, NOT A PICTURE OF IT. 139 generated pages, examples embedded as live Storybook iframes (565 stories, 427 of them live) measured in-page so each frame is the height of what actually paints. Screenshots remain behind --shots only; the default is real DOM, because a PNG cannot be inspected, themed or tabbed into. THE FIRST GUARDRAIL THAT READS PIXELS: check-rendered-geometry drives a real browser over all 447 stories and reports overflow, clipping, zero-size controls, sub-24px targets, links with no affordance and misaligned rows — 57 accepted in a baseline, fingerprinted WITHOUT magnitude so a card overflowing 127px then 130px stays one unfixed defect. Every previous gate was textual and structurally blind to rendered output; #245's 55 broken dark aliases passed all of them. PROBING AN EXTERNAL DESIGN SYSTEM FOUND A BUG IN OUR OWN GATE: 3 of 18 HeroUI cases failed to mount and the probe reported ZERO findings for all three — indistinguishable from a clean pass. The same vacuous green had already hidden 3 StackedCardRail stories here. An empty-render detector now short-circuits it; swept across all 447, HDS has none. THE FOUR RECORDS THAT DESCRIBE A COMPONENT NOW REFERENCE EACH OTHER, AND THE JOIN IS GATED ON EVERY COMMIT. Source file, manifest entry, Storybook story, Figma node — none of them pointed at the others, so answering 'is Table in sync and where do I edit it' meant reading hds-manifest.json, figma-disposition's classification, figma/disposition.json's overrides and a glob of *.stories.tsx, then holding the join in your head. That is the actual reason a defect list gets reported from memory instead of looked up. THE MANIFEST — the declared source of truth for inventory and Figma links — COULD NOT ANSWER 'WHERE IS BUTTON'S STORY'. The link was derivable from source all along, which is worse than missing: 128 of 139 components had a story and no tool could say so, so nothing could gate it. enrich-manifest now writes storyFiles and storyIds onto every spec, always, including as empty arrays, because a component with no story is a fact worth recording and an absent field reads as 'not yet computed'. scripts/check-sync-map.mjs prints one row per component with a verdict: 139 components, 91 in sync, story coverage 120/120, Figma 47/88, 41 missing a node, 13 carrying rendered defects. EXPECTATIONS COME FROM THE RATIFIED DISPOSITION (hds#235), NOT FROM THE COMPONENT COUNT: a layout primitive renders no pixels and a slot is modelled inside its parent, so neither is reported as missing a Figma node it was never supposed to have, and an internal component is not missing a story nobody wants. Counting all 139 would have manufactured 32 false gaps and made the gate one nobody reads. STORY IDS ARE DERIVED FROM SOURCE, NOT READ FROM storybook-static, so the gate needs no build and no browser — 0.6s, which is what earns it a place in the lean pre-commit set instead of being the 31st gate recorded as firing that fires from nothing. A test asserts the derivation against the real index.json, and it immediately caught two ids that resolved to nothing: code-block.stories.tsx exports StatusChip and ComponentList as sample content ABOVE its meta, and Storybook does not index exports declared before `export default`. THE GATE RE-DERIVES RATHER THAN TRUSTING spec.storyIds, because reading only the recorded value would let a stale manifest pass a gate whose entire job is to prove the records agree. Canary: trimming Button's recorded ids to 2 fails with 'the manifest records 2 story id(s), source has 9 — run pnpm manifest:generate'. Two bugs fixed on the way: figma-disposition.mjs ran its whole report on import and corrupted this gate's --json output (same shape as the check-link-integrity finding in #255 — a module that runs its own gate on import is not importable), and the first source-file check globbed src/ only, reporting all seven Compiler primitives as missing their own source when they legitimately declare scripts/hds-jsx-compiler.mjs.
next: THE COMPONENT REFERENCE SITE IS BUILT BY `pnpm docs:site` AND PUBLISHED BY CI, never by an agent — .github/workflows/docs-site.yml, guarded the way chromatic.yml is. Output is gitignored: a checked-in page is one more generated artifact that can go stale while asserting it is current. The deployed URL lands in the workflow run's summary.

docs/sync-map.json IS COMMITTED GENERATED OUTPUT WITH NO DRIFT GATE — the one artifact in this branch that contradicts the branch's own policy for docs/components/. Either gate it (`--check`, the pattern figma:staging-inventory already uses) or gitignore it. Filed rather than fixed, to keep the site PR scoped.

EDITING TARGETS ARE NOW A LOOKUP: `pnpm sync-map` for every component with a gap, `node scripts/check-sync-map.mjs --component Table` for one component's source file, story files, story ids, Figma node and defect count. docs/sync-map.json is the same data for agents.

THE ONLY REMAINING SYNC GAP THAT IS REAL WORK: 41 of 88 library components have no Figma node. Story coverage is 120/120 and variable drift is 2, so Figma components are the last axis out of sync. Follow figma/COMPONENT-DRAWING-RECIPE.md; the 41 are listed by category in `pnpm figma:disposition`.

3 STORY FILES RESOLVE TO NO COMPONENT IN THE MANIFEST, and two of them are a real inconsistency to decide: HistoryCard and NotFoundPattern have source files, have Storybook stories, and are exported from src/index.ts (so `import { HistoryCard } from '@hirobius/design-system'` works) — yet the manifest does not list them, because both are marked @internal + @doc-exempt. Either they belong in the manifest or they should not be in the public barrel; removing an export is breaking, so this is Adrian's call. The third, static-primitives.stories.tsx, imports nothing and is CSS-only — fine as-is.

13 COMPONENTS CARRY RENDERED DEFECTS, now attributable by name rather than by memory: Table (5), Breadcrumb (4), CinematicLink, DateTimeInput, DateInput, Carousel, StackedCardRail, Tokenizer, Disclosure, HdsSlider, SegmentedControl, Sketch, VisuallyHidden. FIX ORDER BY BLAST RADIUS: (1) Table — a primitive every pattern composes, Token column is 240px against 258px of content. (2) DateTimeInput — 2 controls rendering at 0x0, the only unclickable elements in the system. (3) Breadcrumb — 9 link-no-affordance, a WCAG 1.4.1 failure. (4) StackedCardRail — 13 overflow-x, but #133 may delete it, so confirm before spending.

32 small-target FINDINGS ARE ONE SYSTEM-WIDE QUESTION, NOT 32 BUGS: Tokenizer (8), Disclosure (6), HdsSlider (6), DateInput (4). WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8 wants 24px. If the answer is a minimum hit-area on every interactive primitive, that is one token and one shared class.

check-rendered-geometry IS STILL on-demand AND THAT IS HONEST — it needs a built Storybook (~2 min) so it cannot join the pre-commit set. Wiring it to ci-pr is a .github/workflows edit, which IS pushable from a remote session (#267 proved it). Do NOT relabel the channel without wiring it.

56 STORIES ALREADY HAVE play() FUNCTIONS AND NOTHING RUNS THEM. @storybook/test-runner is config-only to wire and brings axe-per-story with it. It now shares infrastructure with check-rendered-geometry (a built Storybook + Chromium at /opt/pw-browsers), so the marginal cost has dropped.
MERGE ORDER, all three are mine, all green, all independent: #267 (release PAT — merge FIRST, it unblocks every publish), #268 ('use client'), #269 (props exports).

#270 filed — scripts/lib/check-public-api.mjs is wired NOWHERE while its own docblock claims it runs in check:full as api:check.
A RED CI DOES NOT STOP A PUBLISH. .github/workflows/release.yml has no `needs:`, no `workflow_run` and no `if:` tying it to the CI workflow.
A COMPONENT CAN VANISH FROM THE PUBLISHED BARREL WITH CI GREEN. pretest runs audit-component-integrity with --completeness but never --api. Adding --api to pretest is ~8 lines.

CHROMATIC CANNOT FAIL A PR EVEN ONCE ENABLED: .github/workflows/chromatic.yml:51 sets exitZeroOnChanges: true. As configured it is a report, not a gate — and check-rendered-geometry now covers part of what it was wanted for.
CI HAS NO SECRETS SCAN. gitleaks is referenced in no .github/workflows file and check-secrets is pre-commit only, where it skips silently when the binary is absent.
RECONCILE severity WITH REALITY: several gates say severity warn while exiting 1 in pretest and therefore blocking CI.
THREE GENERATED ARTIFACTS ARE STALE AND NOTHING REGENERATES THEM: docs/audits/TIER_AUDIT.md, docs/security/sbom.json, docs/audits/exceptions-audit.md.
#257 — Radio animates backgroundColor/borderColor to var() strings framer-motion cannot interpolate, so the colour transition silently never runs.
THE BIGGEST DESIGNER-FACING WIN, still never run: FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN=<token> pnpm figma:links --dev-resources --dry-run, then without --dry-run.

(2) Create a token at https://vercel.com/account/settings/tokens named `hds-docs-site-ci`, then add it as an Actions SECRET named VERCEL_TOKEN at https://github.com/hirobius/hds/settings/secrets/actions/new. (3) Run it at https://github.com/hirobius/hds/actions/workflows/docs-site.yml. The Vercel project is created by the workflow on first run — nothing to set up in the dashboard first.

ADRIAN, ONE CHECKBOX, AND IT GATES EVERYTHING SHIPPED TODAY: https://github.com/organizations/hirobius/settings/actions -> General -> Workflow permissions -> tick "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests". Nothing publishes past 0.13.0 until this is ticked, so the dead-guard fix and the broken-types fix sit in the repo and reach no consumer. This is #199 and it is an org SETTING, not code.

FIGMA IS STILL NOT CONSUMABLE BY OTHER DESIGNERS, and the first drift run is the evidence rather than a guess. Dark mode holds Light's values; Role (20 vars), Brand (3) and Density (1) do not exist in Figma at all; 41 of 88 library components have no Figma node; 251 scopes mismatches put variables in the wrong property pickers; 121 hiddenFromPublishing mismatches publish the wrong things to the shared library. AND all of it was measured on the STAGING copy — the published library c8MaVgwxOlxm4wr8wnH0Z4 that consumers actually resolve from has never been snapshotted, so its true state remains unmeasured

resolvedThisSession: PR #262 AND #261 ARE MERGED (c1561f5, 22ec2b5). Everything the previous revision of this file marked 'awaiting merge' is now on main: the 150 rewritten .d.ts specifiers and their gate, the registry channel relabel of 24 gates, and the three dead import.meta.env guards.

'use client' SHIPPED PER CHUNK, gated both directions (PR #268, open, green). scripts/lib/rsc-directive.mjs holds the rule so the build plugin and the standing gate cannot drift; check-rsc-directives re-derives it from dist/ rather than trusting the plugin ran. Canary: stripping the directive from dist/scroll.js makes the gate exit 1 naming that file. A spec review called the gate's import regex a confirmed LIVE bug; verified against real dist/ and the claim was wrong — Rollup renders import statements, esbuild only minifies chunk bodies, so imports always arrive spaced (11 scanned, 0 missing, 0 spurious). The fragility was real and was fixed anyway, tests first.

41 PROPS TYPES EXPORTED, gated from pretest (PR #269, open). The rule was written test-first and the tests earned it: the first pass read only an inline `export` modifier and silently missed three forms this codebase leans on — the trailing `export { CardHeader, ... }` in card.tsx, `Object.assign(GridInner, { Item: GridItem })`, and the one class component. Three tests for those went red before the rule grew; two guards (class STATE is not props; an inner component nothing re-exports stays private) went green FIRST, so the fix could not be satisfied by widening the net. Count went 35 -> 41. Canary: dropping `export` from AlertProps makes the gate exit 1 naming alert.tsx:61.

THE RELEASE DEADLOCK DIAGNOSED AND FIXED (PR #267, open, green). Not the org checkbox after all, or not only: GitHub's anti-recursion guard means no workflow run starts from a GITHUB_TOKEN-authored event, so PR #266 was born with zero checks. Option B (a PAT) was taken over an admin bypass deliberately, so the required checks keep meaning something.

A REAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED WHILE BUILDING THE SECRETS WORK: the Supabase probe 404'd against the live ops project with PGRST125 because it appended /rest/v1/leads to a SUPABASE_URL that already carried /rest/v1 — the exact failure lib/supabase/server.mjs's own comment warns about. Fixed by reusing that sanitization, re-run clean against the live key, regression-tested.

RECORD-KEEPING CORRECTION, caught by the leak-proof sweep and verified: the previous revision of this file named scripts/add-dts-extensions.mjs and scripts/check-published-types.mjs as present-tense fact. Neither exists on this branch or on main — both live in PR #262, unmerged. Every entry below now names the PR it depends on. A record file that asserts unmerged work as done is the same defect this session spent the day removing from the guardrail registry, committed in the one file whose job is to be true.

PUBLISHED TYPES FIX WRITTEN AND VERIFIED, AWAITING MERGE OF PR #262 (nothing below is on main yet). 150 extensionless specifiers rewritten by scripts/add-dts-extensions.mjs; every entry point now green under node16 (from ESM) and bundler. Gated by scripts/check-published-types.mjs from smoke:consumer. Canary proven both directions: rebuilding dist/types without the fixer restores all 150 and the gate exits 1 with the diagnosis; running the fixer returns it to 0. attw profile is esm-only because there is no CJS build here and node10 cannot read exports, so both of those findings are design rather than regressions; the four CSS subpaths are excluded because a stylesheet has no types to resolve.

REGISTRY CHANNEL HONESTY, AWAITING MERGE OF PR #262. The manual/pnpm-meta allowance removed from check-validator-wiring; 24 entries relabelled by the validator's own detection rather than by hand. Canary proven: setting check-source-canon back to manual makes the validator exit 1 naming the drift and fails exactly the three substantive assertions in the new test while the vacuity guard still passes.

THREE DEAD SHIPPED GUARDS, AWAITING MERGE OF PR #261. icon.tsx, deprecation.ts, TenantContext.tsx no longer read import.meta.env. Verified in dist/: zero import.meta.env, zero typeof process, the bare process.env.NODE_ENV member expression present. A first attempt guarded that read with typeof process, which a bundler leaves as a runtime check that a browser bundle always fails, inverting the answer in a production build; measured with esbuild and corrected before merge.

audit-gates-supportjson PROBE COHORT RESTORED, AWAITING MERGE OF PR #262. It selected its cohort with firingChannel !== 'pnpm-meta', so the relabel dropped it from 39 to 15. Now an explicit ID list seeded to match main, failing safe: a gate added tomorrow is included by default.

#236 CLOSED and figma/snapshot.json is on main (PR #258). Proven along the way that no agent can ever take it: the carrier runs fine through use_figma and returns a valid checksum (90bf34df), but use_figma truncates its response at 20 KB while the file is 255 KB — 12.8x — and --ingest checksums the exact bytes. A transport ceiling, not a credential problem. Two earlier failures were misread as transcription error before the runtime was shown to return function source verbatim and all ten functions to transmit byte-perfect; the guard was never at fault. The full DoD, the --json report and where each drift item is tracked are recorded in a closing comment on #236
